text:
paul (auditor): Hey team, auditor asks for a scoped evidence bundle after an RBAC change on infra/ingest-writer around 2026-06-12T03:14:00Z. We need RBAC delta, KMS Decrypt events for keys with alias/redwood-ingest-*, and any downstream S3 GETs in 03:00-03:30 UTC. Keep it minimal and redact PII.

tess: Copy that. Which binding name?

paul (auditor): RoleBinding name: ingest-writer-binding. Change recorded ~03:14.

omar: Plan: slice kube-apiserver audit for RoleBinding update, IRSA annotation map, CloudTrail Decrypts filtered by key alias, and S3 access rows. We'll hash object keys in bundle and include a short correlation note per decrypt.

tess: CLI snippets I'll run: 
 kubectl --context=prod get events --all-namespaces --field-selector involvedObject.name=ingest-writer-binding -o json > kube_rbac_slice.json
 aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2026-06-12T03:00:00Z --end-time 2026-06-12T03:30:00Z --query 'Events[]' > decrypts.json
 aws s3api select-object-content --bucket redwood-access-logs --key 2026/06/12/03/logs.gz --expression "SELECT s._1, s._7, s._10 WHERE s._1 BETWEEN '2026-06-12T03:00:00Z' AND '2026-06-12T03:30:00Z'" --expression-type SQL --output json > s3_reads.json

omar: Cross-correlation notes: match requestParameters.keyId and userIdentity.arn from Decrypt events to the IRSA-mapped role. Also check STS session issuance timestamps. If a decrypt session was issued before 03:14, it's likely unrelated.

paul (auditor): Please include a manifest.txt listing files + sha256 checksums, extract_cmds.sh, and a 1-line rationale per decrypt in correlation_notes.md. If ambiguous, mark "needs further forensics" and ping oncall.

evidence-bot: Preparing package: pkg_6281234000_20260612.zip. Will include: manifest.txt, kube_rbac_slice.json, irsa_map.txt, decrypts.json, s3_reads.json, correlation_notes.md, redaction_log.txt, extract_cmds.sh. Presigned link valid 7 days.

tess: We'll redact emails/usernames and replace full object keys with sha256 placeholders. redaction_log.txt will map placeholders to redaction rationale (not raw values).

omar: Quick sanity: I see two Decrypt events at 03:10 and 03:16. First predates RBAC change, second postdates. We'll validate session ARN for 03:16 and include token-issue logs if needed.

paul (auditor): If 03:16 decrypt session ARN shows creation before 03:14, mark unrelated; otherwise escalate.

evidence-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-compliance-exports/pkg_6281234000_20260612.zip (presigned https://presigned.example/pkg/6281234000). sha256: a1b2c3d4...

paul (auditor): Downloading now. Thanks for the quick turnaround. I'll post any follow-ups here.
